_note: City-level youthful-active-lifestyle scores, one per law-school city. This replaces the old state-level 'community' score because lifestyle varies enormously within a state (Austin vs. Lubbock). Sub-signals are 1-5: social = nightlife/dining/music/young-professional density (weighted heaviest); outdoors = active outdoor recreation; walkability = walkable/transit vs. car-dependent. lifestyleScore = 0.5*social + 0.25*outdoors + 0.25*walkability, rounded to the nearest 0.5. Editable estimates, not survey data.
